title: HR portal rejects employee's leave request
description: The HR portal returns an error when an employee submits annual leave, while other HR pages work.
handling: HR Systems reproduced the date-validation error, corrected the employee's calendar entitlement, and deployed a validation fix.
selfService: Check that the requested dates are within the current leave year and that no overlapping request is pending.
resolution: The employee's leave-year balance had not rolled forward. HR corrected the balance and engineering fixed the missed rollover case; the request was resubmitted successfully.

title: Payroll payslip is missing overtime hours
description: The latest payslip does not include approved overtime entered before the payroll cutoff.
handling: Payroll compared the approved timesheet with the payroll export, identified a delayed approval sync, and issued a corrected payslip.
selfService: Confirm overtime is approved in the timesheet before the published payroll cutoff; do not submit payroll or bank details by email.
resolution: A manager approval arrived after the export snapshot. Payroll issued a corrected payslip and the HR Systems team repaired the delayed sync.

title: New starter cannot open the onboarding checklist
description: A new hire signs in successfully but receives an access denied message on the onboarding checklist.
handling: HR Systems checked the joiner workflow, added the employee to the onboarding group, and verified access with the manager.
selfService: Sign out and back in once after your start date; if access remains denied, ask your manager to confirm the onboarding task was created.
resolution: The joiner workflow omitted the onboarding group for this office. The group was added and the automated provisioning rule was corrected.

title: Expense report stuck at manager review
description: An expense report has remained in manager review for several days although the manager says it was approved.
handling: Finance Systems inspected the approval audit trail, replayed the stuck workflow event, and confirmed the report moved to payment review.
selfService: Open the report's approval history and verify the approver; contact that approver if the report is still awaiting action.
resolution: A transient workflow event was not delivered to the finance queue. Support replayed the event and added monitoring for delayed approvals.

title: Expense receipt upload fails on mobile
description: Uploading a photographed receipt from a mobile device ends with a file type error.
handling: Finance Systems confirmed an image metadata parsing defect, applied the service patch, and validated uploads from supported phones.
selfService: If policy permits, try a clear JPG or PDF under the portal's stated size limit; retain the original receipt.
resolution: The mobile camera added an orientation metadata variant the uploader did not recognize. Engineering patched the parser and the receipt uploaded.

title: Vendor invoice shows an incorrect tax amount
description: The tax amount on a vendor invoice is different from the approved purchase order.
handling: Finance validated the jurisdiction and purchase-order tax codes, corrected the invoice mapping, and issued an adjusted statement.
selfService: Compare the invoice currency, service location, and purchase-order tax code; submit discrepancies through the secure finance portal.
resolution: A stale tax code was attached to the vendor profile. Finance corrected the profile and issued an adjusted invoice for review.

title: Monthly cost center report excludes a department
description: The finance report totals are lower than expected because one department is absent.
handling: Finance Systems compared report filters with the org hierarchy and restored the department after an outdated mapping was found.
selfService: Check the report period and selected cost centers before exporting; ask the cost-center owner to verify the department mapping.
resolution: The department had been moved to a new cost center that was not included in the saved report. The mapping and report filter were updated.

title: Purchase order approval email link is expired
description: The approver's email link says it is expired even though the purchase order is still pending.
handling: Finance Systems confirmed the notification link used an obsolete host name, regenerated the approval request, and updated the mail template.
selfService: Open the purchase order directly from the finance portal instead of using an old email bookmark.
resolution: A host-name change left the email template pointing to the retired portal. The template was corrected and the approver received a fresh link.

title: VPN disconnects every few minutes from home
description: The VPN connects but drops repeatedly during calls; office network access is stable.
handling: Network Operations correlated tunnel logs with a regional gateway issue, moved the session to a healthy gateway, and monitored stability.
selfService: Use the approved VPN client and a stable network; note the disconnect time and client version when reporting a repeat.
resolution: A regional VPN gateway had an unstable network route. The session was moved to a healthy gateway and the route was repaired.

title: Shared drive reports that the storage quota is full
description: A team cannot save documents because its shared drive shows no remaining space.
handling: Workplace Technology identified large duplicate archives, restored write capacity, and agreed a retention plan with the drive owner.
selfService: Review the approved retention policy and remove only files you own that are no longer needed; do not delete shared records without the owner.
resolution: Duplicate temporary archives consumed the quota. The owner approved their cleanup and the storage alert threshold was adjusted.

title: Meeting room display has no signal
description: The meeting room screen shows no signal even though the laptop is connected to the dock.
handling: The service desk checked the room kit, replaced a faulty cable, and ran a test call with the requester.
selfService: Select the room display input and reconnect the approved cable; avoid unplugging room equipment during an active meeting.
resolution: A damaged HDMI adapter caused the loss of signal. Workplace Technology replaced it and tested the room setup.

title: Company-wide identity provider sign-in outage
description: Users across multiple departments cannot sign in to any federated application; critical work is blocked.
handling: The identity on-call team declared an incident, failed over to the healthy identity node, and coordinated status updates with service owners.
selfService: No user-side action is needed during a confirmed identity outage; follow the official status channel and do not repeatedly reset passwords.
resolution: A failed identity node caused federated sign-in failures. The on-call team failed over service and restored authentication; follow-up monitoring was added.

title: Authenticator prompt loops after device replacement
description: A user replaced a phone and now gets repeated authenticator prompts despite entering the current code.
handling: Identity Support verified the user's identity through the approved process, removed the stale device registration, and enrolled the replacement.
selfService: Use a saved recovery code if available; otherwise request identity verification rather than sharing a one-time code with support.
resolution: The old phone remained registered as the primary authenticator. Support replaced the registration and verified the new device.

title: Shared mailbox access missing after team transfer
description: A staff member moved teams and lost access to a shared mailbox still required for transition work.
handling: Identity Support confirmed manager approval and the mailbox owner, then restored time-limited transition access.
selfService: Ask the mailbox owner or manager to submit the access request with the required end date.
resolution: The team transfer automatically removed the former group membership. The owner approved temporary access and a review date was recorded.

title: Suspicious sign-in alert for an employee account
description: An employee received an unfamiliar sign-in alert and cannot confirm the location shown.
handling: Security Operations treated the alert as a potential compromise, revoked active sessions, verified the employee through a separate channel, and reviewed sign-in logs.
selfService: Do not approve an unfamiliar prompt or share codes. Use the official security reporting channel immediately.
resolution: The alert was traced to a blocked credential-stuffing attempt. Sessions were revoked as a precaution and the account was secured after verification.

title: Password reset link says it has already been used
description: A user opens the newest reset message but the link says it is invalid or already used.
handling: Identity Support checked the reset audit trail and found an older link was opened first; support invalidated all links and issued one fresh message.
selfService: Request one new link and open only the latest message; reset links are single-use and expire quickly.
resolution: A mail security scanner consumed the earlier single-use link. Support issued a fresh link and adjusted the scanner policy.

title: Customer portal returns an error when saving a profile
description: Saving a profile with an accented surname produces a server error; plain-text names work.
handling: Engineering reproduced the encoding defect, corrected Unicode normalization, and verified existing profile records were unchanged.
selfService: Keep your entered profile data and retry after the service notice; do not replace correct personal details with inaccurate values.
resolution: A text normalization path rejected valid Unicode characters. Engineering corrected validation and confirmed accented names save successfully.

title: Search results omit newly added documents
description: Documents uploaded today do not appear in search although older documents are returned normally.
handling: Engineering inspected the indexing queue, replayed failed jobs, and fixed a worker timeout that interrupted new document indexing.
selfService: Confirm the upload completed and check the document's access scope; allow a short indexing delay before retrying search.
resolution: A background indexing worker timed out on a large file. Jobs were replayed and the timeout handling was corrected.

title: Desktop application crashes during launch
description: The desktop client closes immediately after launch following the latest operating-system update.
handling: Endpoint Engineering collected the approved diagnostic bundle, identified an incompatible graphics component, and deployed a signed client update.
selfService: Restart once and install only updates offered through the company software center; retain the diagnostic time if it repeats.
resolution: The latest OS update exposed an unsupported graphics library version. A signed compatible client build was deployed.

title: Scheduled report ran twice overnight
description: Two identical scheduled reports were delivered to the same distribution list.
handling: Engineering reviewed scheduler execution IDs, removed the duplicate queued job, and patched a retry path that could enqueue twice.
selfService: Check the schedule owner and recipient list before changing a recurring report; retain one copy for audit purposes.
resolution: A retry after a delayed acknowledgement created a second scheduled job. The duplicate was removed and job creation made idempotent.

title: Browser page stays blank after a software update
description: The internal portal loads a blank page in one browser after an update but works on another device.
handling: The service desk confirmed a stale cached bundle, guided the user through a targeted cache refresh, and verified the portal on the affected browser.
selfService: Try a private window first; if that works, clear cached site data for this portal only and sign in again.
resolution: A stale browser bundle referenced an old asset. Clearing that site's cached data restored the current page.

title: API integration returns rate-limit errors
description: A reporting integration began receiving HTTP 429 responses after its request volume increased.
handling: Integration Engineering reviewed request metrics, identified an unbounded retry loop, and helped the owner apply exponential backoff and batching.
selfService: Reduce polling frequency, honor Retry-After, and use bounded backoff instead of immediate repeated retries.
resolution: The client retried rate-limited calls without delay. Bounded exponential backoff and request batching returned traffic to the supported limit.

title: Webhook events arrive more than once
description: An order-processing webhook sometimes delivers the same event two or three times.
handling: Integration Engineering confirmed retries followed slow acknowledgements and worked with the consumer team to add idempotency keys.
selfService: Treat webhook delivery as at-least-once and deduplicate by the event identifier before applying changes.
resolution: Slow acknowledgements caused legitimate retries. The consumer began deduplicating by event ID and the sender timeout was tuned.

title: SFTP import rejects files with a new naming pattern
description: The overnight import stopped accepting files after a vendor added a date suffix to the filename.
handling: Integration Engineering reviewed the vendor change, updated the allow-listed filename pattern, and replayed the missed import after validating the checksum.
selfService: Do not rename or re-upload financial files manually; attach the exact filename and delivery timestamp to the incident.
resolution: The vendor's documented date suffix was missing from the allow-list. The pattern was updated and the missed file was safely replayed.

title: Calendar integration stopped syncing after consent expired
description: Calendar events no longer sync and the integration settings show that authorization is required.
handling: Integration Engineering verified the application registration, refreshed delegated consent with the owner, and monitored a test synchronization.
selfService: Use the official integration settings to request reauthorization; never send an access token or secret in a ticket.
resolution: The integration's delegated consent had expired. The owner reauthorized through the approved settings and sync resumed.

title: Finance export contains duplicate transaction rows
description: A finance export includes each transaction twice when a report spans the end of a month.
handling: Finance Systems compared source ledger IDs with export rows, removed a duplicated boundary join, and reconciled the corrected file with Finance.
selfService: Avoid importing the affected export twice; keep its report period and generation ID for reconciliation.
resolution: The date-boundary query joined the final transaction twice. Engineering corrected the query and Finance validated the replacement export.

title: New bank account cannot be verified for reimbursement
description: The reimbursement portal says bank verification is pending beyond the normal processing window.
handling: Finance checked the secure verification provider status, reissued a verification request, and confirmed no account details were exposed to support.
selfService: Check the secure finance portal for a verification notice; do not send bank details by email or chat.
resolution: The verification provider's callback was delayed. Finance reissued the request through the secure portal and confirmed completion.

title: Subscription renewal charged in the wrong currency
description: The latest renewal appears in a different currency from the account's established billing currency.
handling: Billing checked the account's regional setting and transaction record, corrected the billing profile, and issued a credit for the conversion difference.
selfService: Review the billing currency shown in account settings before renewal; contact Billing through the secure portal for corrections.
resolution: A regional profile change switched the default currency before renewal. Billing restored the agreed currency and credited the difference.

title: Invoice PDF download is unavailable
description: The invoice appears in the billing history but the PDF download returns a temporary error.
handling: Billing verified that the invoice record was complete, regenerated the PDF, and corrected a document-rendering queue delay.
selfService: Refresh the billing history and try the download once more; use the secure portal rather than forwarding invoices externally.
resolution: A rendering job remained queued after a service restart. The PDF was regenerated and the queue monitor was repaired.

title: Approved refund is not visible on the payment card
description: A refund was approved several days ago but has not appeared on the card statement yet.
handling: Billing confirmed the processor's settlement reference and shared the expected bank processing window without exposing full card data.
selfService: Check the original payment method and allow the processor's stated business-day window; contact the bank if it passes.
resolution: The payment processor had settled the refund but the card issuer had not posted it. Billing supplied the reference and the issuer posted it in its normal cycle.

title: Product license count does not update after offboarding
description: A former employee was deactivated but the available license count did not increase.
handling: Identity Support confirmed deactivation, released the assigned license, and corrected a delayed synchronization between identity and licensing services.
selfService: Ask an administrator to verify the account is deactivated; do not reuse another person's credentials while the count updates.
resolution: A delayed license synchronization left a stale assignment. The license was reclaimed and the reconciliation job was repaired.

title: Team folder permission change removed read access
description: A team member can no longer read a project folder after a group permission cleanup.
handling: Identity Support confirmed the project owner's approval, restored the least-privilege read group, and reviewed the change audit.
selfService: Ask the folder owner to confirm the intended role and submit an access request; avoid using another person's account.
resolution: The cleanup removed a nested read-only group used by the project. Support restored the approved group and documented its owner.

title: Employee cannot access archived project records
description: An employee needs read-only access to archived records for an audit but receives a permission error.
handling: The records owner approved a time-limited audit role and Identity Support recorded the expiry and verified access logging.
selfService: Provide the audit scope and end date in the access request; archived records remain read-only by design.
resolution: The employee had only active-project permissions. A time-limited read-only audit role was granted with an automatic review date.

title: Teams audio is one-way in external meetings
description: The employee can hear attendees but external attendees cannot hear their microphone.
handling: Workplace Technology checked the approved audio device and meeting policy, corrected the selected microphone, and verified a test call.
selfService: Check the meeting's selected microphone and operating-system mute control before joining; do not install unapproved audio tools.
resolution: The conferencing app was using a disconnected headset microphone. Selecting the active device restored two-way audio.

title: Printer queue holds all jobs after a paper jam
description: The office printer has cleared a paper jam but queued print jobs remain stuck.
handling: The service desk confirmed the printer was clear, restarted its managed queue, and verified a test page with the office contact.
selfService: Remove paper only as indicated on the device; cancel your own stale job and contact the service desk before clearing the shared queue.
resolution: The print service retained a stale jam state. The managed queue was restarted and all new jobs printed normally.

title: Laptop disk encryption recovery prompt appears after update
description: A managed laptop requests an encryption recovery key after a scheduled firmware update.
handling: Endpoint Engineering verified device ownership and compliance, retrieved the recovery key through the secured process, and corrected the firmware policy.
selfService: Contact the service desk using a verified channel; never post a recovery key in chat or an incident description.
resolution: A firmware policy change triggered recovery on this device model. Support recovered the device and corrected the deployment ring.

title: Endpoint security agent reports an outdated signature
description: A managed workstation reports that its security signature has not updated since yesterday.
handling: Security Operations checked management telemetry, restored the update relay connection, and confirmed the endpoint received current protection.
selfService: Keep the device connected to the company network or approved VPN and allow the managed update to retry; do not disable protection.
resolution: The regional update relay was unreachable after maintenance. The relay route was restored and endpoints updated.

title: HR directory shows an old manager after transfer
description: The employee directory still shows the previous manager several days after an approved transfer.
handling: HR Systems compared the personnel record with the directory feed, corrected a failed synchronization, and verified the manager with HR.
selfService: Confirm the transfer is effective in the HR portal; ask HR to correct the source record if it is wrong.
resolution: A failed directory feed left a stale manager value. HR corrected the source record and replayed the sync.

title: Benefits enrollment page will not save a dependent
description: The benefits enrollment page displays a validation error when saving a dependent's information.
handling: HR Systems reviewed the validation rules with the benefits provider, corrected a date-format mismatch, and confirmed a secure resubmission.
selfService: Use the date format shown on the form and submit dependent information only in the authenticated benefits portal.
resolution: The provider changed its date-format contract without updating the portal validator. The format mapping was corrected and enrollment completed.

title: Payroll direct-deposit change misses cutoff
description: A direct-deposit update was saved before payday but the next payslip still shows the previous account.
handling: Payroll checked the change audit timestamp against the published cutoff and confirmed the pending update for the next cycle through a secure channel.
selfService: Submit bank changes only in the verified payroll portal and review its effective-date notice; contact Payroll if the date is unclear.
resolution: The change was approved after the payroll cutoff and remained scheduled for the next cycle. Payroll confirmed the effective date with the employee.

title: How to request temporary elevated access
description: A developer needs short-lived elevated access for a planned maintenance task and asks where to request it.
handling: Identity Support explained the time-bound privileged-access workflow and confirmed the request included an owner, purpose, and expiry.
selfService: Submit the privileged-access form with a specific task and end time; use just-in-time access rather than a standing administrator role.
resolution: The user submitted the approved just-in-time access request. The manager authorized the short maintenance window and access expired automatically.

title: How to export approved timesheets
description: A manager needs a monthly export of approved team timesheets for reconciliation.
handling: The service desk showed the manager the approved-timesheet filter and secure export location, then confirmed the month and team scope.
selfService: Choose the relevant month and Approved status before export; store the file only in the approved finance location.
resolution: The manager used the monthly approved-timesheet report and downloaded the export to the authorized location.

title: How to correct a submitted expense report
description: An employee submitted an expense with the wrong cost center and asks how to correct it before approval.
handling: Finance checked that the report was still editable and guided the employee to amend the cost center before manager review.
selfService: If the report is still a draft, edit it in the finance portal; after submission, request recall through the report's action menu.
resolution: The report had not yet been approved. The employee recalled it, corrected the cost center, and resubmitted for approval.

title: Request for a searchable audit export
description: A department requests a searchable export format for audit records that are currently delivered as a PDF.
handling: Product Support gathered the audit workflow, retention requirements, and affected roles, then linked the request to the existing export roadmap item.
selfService: Include the audit task and required fields in the product feedback form; do not export sensitive records to unapproved tools.
resolution: The request was documented for product review and linked to the existing reporting roadmap. No delivery date was promised.

title: Request for scheduled invoice reminders
description: A finance administrator asks for automatic reminders before monthly invoices are due.
handling: Product Support recorded the reminder cadence, recipient controls, and audit needs and shared the request with Product.
selfService: Use the existing billing calendar reminder while Product evaluates the request; avoid sharing invoice details in public channels.
resolution: Product accepted the request for discovery and documented the required controls. The customer was updated that prioritization and timing are undecided.
